name: Transguard Group
desc: UAE business support and outsourcing group providing cash services, security, manpower, facilities management, aviation and catering services.
products: Cash services, protective security, event security, manpower and hospitality staffing, HR outsourcing, facilities management, aviation services, Taste of Home catering
customers: Government entities, airports and aviation, corporates; contracts named with DIEZ, Dubai Health, Zayed National Museum, Taaleem, Union Co-Op, Dutco, Arabian Adventures
parent_ultimate: The Emirates Group (Dubai government-owned group; ultimate owner requires verification)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own brand, CEO and newsroom; Emirates Group chairman sits on its executive board
stores_or_sites: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Ras Al-Khaimah locations
markets: United Arab Emirates; recruitment partnerships in Sri Lanka and Pakistan; myTVS agreement to extend regional footprint beyond UAE
expansion_markets: Regional expansion beyond the UAE via myTVS agreement (stated in FY25/26 results release)
profitability_basis: Profit before tax AED 350m in FY25/26, up 32% (company release 22 Jun 2026)

signals.what: Record FY25/26 results: revenue AED 3.86bn (+20%), headcount 78,500; new protective services, FM and workforce contracts
MOU with myTVS to extend regional footprint beyond the UAE
Strategic partnerships at Intersec 2026 (DGB security technology, FAAC access control, Polaris Cement)
Taste of Home catering brand wins AED 11m in new catering contracts

fit._note: ecosystem: sister company Emirates is an F1 partner

fit_rationale: UAE's largest outsourcing group (78,500 staff) serving government, aviation and events; Abu Dhabi race security, staffing and cash logistics are its core competences and Gulf B2B hospitality fits.
category_conflict: Sister company Emirates (Emirates Group) holds Formula 1 partnerships; no F1 partner found in cash/security outsourcing

access.roles: Chief Executive Officer; Chief Financial and Support Services Officer; Emirates Group executive board

outstanding: Confirm ultimate ownership (Emirates Group owner) and marketing budget authority; Emirates' F1 role may shape any approach
